questions.question: When spies asked Jesus about paying taxes to Caesar, what did He tell them to do?

answers.text: Give Caesar what is his and God what is His
Give Caesar nothing and give God everything
Give God first and Caesar what is left over

questions.question: The Sadducees who came to question Jesus said there is no resurrection of the dead. True or false?
When the Sadducees asked Jesus about the resurrection, why did He say those raised can no longer die?

answers.text: Because they are like the angels
Because they never sinned on earth
Because they live far from the earth
